money.summary: Carmen is a scam target. Any request for money, gift cards, crypto, wires or bank details in a family member's name is checked with that member before she sends anything (R-MONEY-VERIFY); unconfirmed means don't send (R-MONEY-DEFAULT). Village itself never moves money (R-MONEY-NEVER).
